Chocolate chunk blondies Ingredients: 1/2 cup melted butter 1 cup dark brown sugar (I used light, it was all I had) 1 large egg 1 tsp vanilla extract  1/2 tsp baking powder  1/8 tsp baking soda 1/8 tsp salt 1 cup flour 4 oz semi sweet chocolate chopped Instructions: 1.Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and line an 8x8in pan with parchment paper. 2.In a medium bowl mix together melted butter and sugar then add in egg and vanilla extract. 3.Fold in flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt until just combined then fold in chocolate chunks. 4.Pour into pan and spread evenly. Then bake for 18-22 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 5.Let cool completely then cut into squares and enjoy!
